propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless and conflates two distinct causes (bound-exceeded and signal-unavailable) that require opposite remediations
CloudWatch-only monitoring cannot distinguish signal-unavailable (probe broken, deploys blind) from bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain check working) without shell access

observability.sh must emit two separate metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) by filtering journal patterns while keeping rolled-up review_interrupts for history

monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-specific alarms, each with its own remediation description, keeping signal-unavailable's 1-datapoint latching behavior
terraform apply in infra/terraform must be executed to activate the alarm contract changes and replace the old single alarm with the two new reason-scoped alarms
